release_claim.reason: All 113 corrections have accepted source, test, fault, visual, and exact-artifact evidence; certification remains owned by the final current section/group receipts, governed full profile, and validate operation.

findings.finding: The clean tree fails its canonical validator.
findings.evidence: `validate` returns `valid:false` because `registry/provider_route_scan.json` is stale. A release handoff that cannot pass its first documented control is not certifiable.
findings.required_correction: Rebuild the provider-route index from the exact final bytes and make export refuse stale output.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Three content identities in the provider route scan are stale.
findings.evidence: `runtime/resource_lifecycle.py`: stored 43,617 bytes / `415ee5...`, current 47,732 / `be781e...`; `runtime/test_runner.py`: 4,619 / `7886bb...`, current 9,613 / `f16986...`; `scripts/clean_source_export.py`: 4,446 / `dc202f...`, current 4,795 / `91c6f7...`.
findings.required_correction: Make the index a generated build prerequisite, not a best-effort afterthought.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Two required section receipts are stale.
findings.evidence: `dashboard-extension` and `execution-placement` have `passed:true` but `fresh:false`, `current:false`.
findings.required_correction: Re-run governed section tests after final source changes and bind receipts to exact inputs.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Every required group receipt is stale.
findings.evidence: All 10 groups (`core-a-f`, `core-g-m`, `core-n-s`, `core-t-z`, `process-recovery`, `exact-installed`, `release-build`, `release-audit`, `derived-integrity`, `structural-adversarial`) are non-current across all 175 members.
findings.required_correction: Re-run every required group against the exact export candidate.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Full certification refuses to start.
findings.evidence: `test-profile run full` stops with “whole certification requires current section receipts” before executing a suite.
findings.required_correction: Make current section receipts an export precondition, then complete the full profile.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: A failed obsolete receipt ships beside the current receipt set.
findings.evidence: `.engineering-bootstrap/test-evidence/groups/core-n-z.json` is not a required group and records exit 1 / `passed:false` after ~416 s.
findings.required_correction: Remove obsolete authority or move it into an explicitly historical, non-current namespace.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: The source-only exporter removes state required by `audit structure`.
findings.evidence: The command fails on missing `.engineering-bootstrap/project-management/state.json`; `clean_source_export.py:43-49` excludes all non-test-evidence engineering state.
findings.required_correction: Either make structure audit source-only aware or include a portable, sanitized seed state needed by the audit.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Release and generated-artifact checks require another excluded file.
findings.evidence: `audit release` and `validate_generated_artifacts` fail on `.engineering-bootstrap/project-registry.json`; the latter throws instead of returning a governed failure.
findings.required_correction: Remove the hidden runtime dependency, ship a portable registry, and convert missing prerequisites into structured fail-closed results.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: The effect-surface ownership registry is stale.
findings.evidence: Runtime scan finds 671 surfaces; `registry/build_claims.json` and the dashboard claim 667.
findings.required_correction: Rebuild registry and claims from the same final scan.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: New hard-delete surfaces bypass lifecycle policy.
findings.evidence: `runtime/test_runner.py:162` and `:240` call `shutil.rmtree`; the effect validator explicitly prohibits them.
findings.required_correction: Route cleanup through `ResourceManager`/quarantine policy and require an owned disposition receipt.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Evidence portability fails at scale.
findings.evidence: 1,327 external locators produce 1,328 errors: 1,312 in `px-generated-test-fixture-cleanup`, 7 in `owned-test-cache-cleanup`, and 4 each in the two pytest cleanup records. The registry claims zero.
findings.required_correction: Sanitize or classify every locator, rebuild the historical-reference registry, and fail export on divergence.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Personal absolute paths remain in the “clean” handoff.
findings.evidence: A narrow raw scan found 1,344 escaped `${USER_HOME}` occurrences across 14 files, plus unescaped home paths in docs, smoke evidence, skill provenance, and scripts.
findings.required_correction: Replace with project-relative or redacted locators; do not ship workstation/user identity in current evidence.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Cleanup evidence proves cleanup was incomplete.
findings.evidence: Pytest receipts retain 2 then 1 item and both say `root_absent:false`; generated-fixture cleanup retains 11. One record claims 1,300 targets, 1,474,985 files, and 374,869,192,070 logical bytes reclaimed.
findings.required_correction: Separate historical forensic evidence from current release evidence; explain retained objects and validate plausible accounting.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: The live sanitation control is nondeterministic on binary bytes.
findings.evidence: It scans every binary chunk with a short identifier regex and flags `extension/evidence/screenshots/surface-memory-1440.png` at byte 320,229. Random compressed data can make a release pass/fail.
findings.required_correction: Classify file types; scan text as decoded text and binaries with admitted binary/metadata tools.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: The sanitation command is not a general sanitation gate.
findings.evidence: Its own result marks secret, credential, PII, binary, and license/provenance review `not_run`; `valid` ignores all five.
findings.required_correction: Compose the real admitted gates and require all required controls to pass before `valid:true`.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Clean export does not execute or verify release controls.
findings.evidence: `create_clean_export` inventories bytes and receipts but does not run validation, currentness, effect, portability, sanitation, secret, PII, license, generated, or full test checks.
findings.required_correction: Make export a finalization transaction that consumes current successful receipts for the exact byte manifest.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: The current evidence index claims an absent VSIX.
findings.evidence: It records `.engineering-bootstrap/quarantine/release-artifacts/vscode/0.6.1/pacify-x-vscode-0.6.1.vsix` (3,953,745 bytes, SHA-256 `34742e...`); that path is not in the archive by design.
findings.required_correction: Never mark an index current when a named artifact is not co-delivered or resolvable through a durable exact locator.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Evidence-index validity ignores receipt currentness.
findings.evidence: `registry/current_evidence_index.json` contains the two stale section receipts yet says `valid:true`; the builder validates presence/hash, not semantic freshness.
findings.required_correction: Require receipt schema, pass, current/fresh, input identity, and namespace validation.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: The evidence index reports no limitations despite missing artifact and stale receipts.
findings.evidence: `limitations: []` misrepresents the bundle’s actual boundaries.
findings.required_correction: Populate machine-readable limitations and derive validity from them.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Installed-VSIX smoke is partial and cannot substitute for the absent artifact.
findings.evidence: The 0.6.1 smoke says artifact hash unchanged, but listener coverage is partial, `coverage_complete:false`, test API unsupported, and extension behaviors unexercised.
findings.required_correction: Retain the exact VSIX and run a complete installed-host suite with explicit supported/unsupported dimensions.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: `doctor` process semantics can fool automation.
findings.evidence: `valid:true` and exit 0 coexist with `operable:false`, `ready:false`, `certification_ready:false`, and a blocked overall state. `runtime/px_doctor.py` builds `valid:true`; CLI exit follows it.
findings.required_correction: Exit nonzero for the requested readiness contract, or expose explicit modes such as syntax-valid vs operable vs certification-ready.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Read-looking audit commands mutate the workspace.
findings.evidence: Every audit command calls `_prepare_certification_hygiene`, whose cleanup uses `apply:true`; caches are moved to quarantine even without a write flag.
findings.required_correction: Default audit to dry-run; require explicit `--apply` and display exact effects before mutation.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Incomplete-implementation review freshness is broken.
findings.evidence: 15 findings are unreviewed after semantic IDs changed. They appear to be Protocol ellipses, but the control still returns `complete:false`.
findings.required_correction: Update review identities/classifications and require the audit before export.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: The repair ledger overstates closure.
findings.evidence: It marks 20 prior items accepted, including BOM cleanup, PII cleanup, current receipts, memory, MCP status, and current evidence, despite current contrary evidence.
findings.required_correction: Derive repair status from executable acceptance checks; do not permit manually optimistic labels to become authority.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: A “valid/certifiable” coverage record is stale against source hashes.
findings.evidence: `evidence/operation-health/final-coverage-20260812.json` says valid/certifiable while provider gateway/tests differ; doctor detects the mismatch.
findings.required_correction: Namespace historical coverage and regenerate exact-source coverage evidence.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Section receipts leak a personal source checkout.
findings.evidence: Six section receipts embed `${USER_HOME}\Downloads\bootstrap_project\Pacify-X\extension`.
findings.required_correction: Store project-relative paths or stable logical roots.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Normal CI never builds or tests the extension.
findings.evidence: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` installs Python and runs Python gates only; no `npm ci`, `npm run check`, Node unit tests, UI tests, or VSIX packaging.
findings.required_correction: Add locked Node install, syntax/unit/UI tests, package audit, and VSIX smoke as required jobs.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Dependency automation omits npm.
findings.evidence: Dependabot covers `pip` and `github-actions` only.
findings.required_correction: Add `npm` for `/extension`, with lockfile and review policy.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Exhaustive assurance is Windows-only and already blocked by stale receipts.
findings.evidence: Scheduled full profile runs only on `windows-latest`; normal macOS CI tests only a small platform subset.
findings.required_correction: Run the process supervisor/studios and full or representative governed groups on Linux, Windows, and macOS.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Release automation publishes only Python artifacts.
findings.evidence: The release workflow builds wheel/sdist and never builds, tests, signs, or publishes the VSIX, while product evidence treats the extension as part of current identity.
findings.required_correction: Add an exact VSIX build/test/sign/publish lane or formally version/release it independently.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: The extension source handoff’s install instructions are incomplete.
findings.evidence: `node_modules` is correctly absent, but `extension/README.md` starts with `npm run check`; it never says `npm ci`, so a clean user immediately gets missing packages such as `zod`.
findings.required_correction: Start with `npm ci`, document tool versions, and distinguish source build from VSIX install.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: The “agent harness” is not an agent harness.
findings.evidence: `agent_harness_worker.py` validates five identity fields, prints `accepted_by_harness`, and explicitly returns `model_invoked:false`; `agent_runtime.py:75` also hardcodes false.
findings.required_correction: Implement an admitted model/worker adapter, real message/task contract, tool dispatch, lifecycle, and independently verified result.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Task content is discarded before launch.
findings.evidence: `invoke_harness` computes a digest but writes only `task_sha256`, binding IDs, and grant IDs. The worker never receives the user task.
findings.required_correction: Store/stream a bounded signed task envelope, or a resolvable content-addressed body with authorization.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Declared tests are never executed.
findings.evidence: `test_candidate` treats `bool(spec.required_tests)` as success. A nonexistent test name passes.
findings.required_correction: Resolve allowed tests, run them through the governed runner, capture exact outputs/inputs, and fail unknown tests.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Agent admission trusts caller-constructed lifecycle state.
findings.evidence: `admit` only checks whether provided dataclass objects have matching IDs and `state == "admitted"`.
findings.required_correction: Resolve bindings/grants from canonical signed registries; callers may submit IDs, never authoritative objects.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Foreign, expired, or mismatched grants can be accepted.
findings.evidence: The code does not verify grant subject, expiry, effect-to-binding linkage, scope roots, approver, evidence, cost, egress, credential namespace, or capability existence. A probe admitted an expired/foreign grant.
findings.required_correction: Validate every semantic link and current time/scope against canonical authority.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Admission receipts are unsigned and forgeable.
findings.evidence: Invocation reads local JSON and checks only `decision:"admitted"` plus record hash. A forged receipt reached process launch.
findings.required_correction: Sign/MAC receipts or store them in an append-only authenticated ledger and verify issuer/scope/nonce/revision.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Invocation does not revalidate live authority.
findings.evidence: Binding/grant IDs are copied into a task record but their current status, expiry, scope, and revocation are never checked.
findings.required_correction: Re-resolve at launch and at every effect boundary; bind their hashes into the runtime receipt.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: There is no start/stop/pause/cancel agent lifecycle.
findings.evidence: Invocation is one synchronous subprocess that exits; returned `runtime_state` is always `stopped`. No controller methods expose stop/cancel/status.
findings.required_correction: Build a supervised long-running session state machine with ownership, heartbeat, cancellation, bounded shutdown, and recovery.
notes: Authenticated pause/cancel/stop/resume, heartbeats, bounded process-tree shutdown, exact-identity restart, stale-owner reconciliation, and event-before-head crash recovery pass adversarial tests.

findings.finding: UI and adapter expose create only.
findings.evidence: The only host message is `createStudioDraft`; `runtime/studio_api.py` only calls `create_candidate`/`save_revision`/`stage_draft`. There is no list/edit/test/admit/bind/run/stop/promote/rollback API.
findings.required_correction: Expose the complete lifecycle with authority-gated commands and live state.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: The promised capability-flow/harness view does not exist.
findings.evidence: Agent Studio is a JSON textarea and a generic catalog. There is no visual mapping of start/stop, model, plugins, workflows, skills, grants, data flow, or test evidence.
findings.required_correction: Add a human editor plus a read-only executable topology and per-edge authority/evidence inspector.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Studio state writes can escape the project through an intermediate symlink.
findings.evidence: `write_versioned_record` resolves only the project root, then writes through `.engineering-bootstrap/...`. A probe made `.engineering-bootstrap` a symlink and created records outside the project.
findings.required_correction: Use descriptor/handle-relative no-follow traversal, verify every ancestor identity, and reject links/reparse points immediately before atomic replace.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Candidate persistence is not fully atomic.
findings.evidence: `record.json` and `instructions.md` use direct `write_text`; a crash can leave partial/mismatched state despite the presence of an atomic JSON helper.
findings.required_correction: Stage the complete revision directory and publish by one atomic directory swap with fsync where supported.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Identity/version normalization is validated but not retained.
findings.evidence: `_identity`/`_version` normalize local variables; frozen dataclass fields keep original case/whitespace. Paths/hashes can diverge for semantically equal IDs.
findings.required_correction: Canonicalize in constructors via `object.__setattr__` or reject noncanonical input.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: The advertised 256 KiB studio payload cannot work on Windows.
findings.evidence: Payload JSON is base64url inside argv. Windows `CreateProcessW` limits the command line to 32,767 characters, so roughly >24 KiB raw payloads fail despite a 256 KiB contract.
findings.required_correction: Send through stdin or an owned temporary file. Microsoft documents the limit [here](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/processthreadsapi/nf-processthreadsapi-createprocessw).
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Create responses are cached for 30 seconds.
findings.evidence: `_request` caches by body hash; a deleted, redirected, or independently changed revision can receive a stale success without rechecking disk.
findings.required_correction: Disable result caching for writes or require an idempotency key plus authoritative post-write readback.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Workspace-less Studio writes fall back to the engine source root.
findings.evidence: `pxBridge.js:304` selects `projectRoot`, otherwise `engineRoot`. Opening Studio without a project can mutate the Pacify-X installation itself.
findings.required_correction: Require an explicit bounded project root; never treat engine source as project state.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: The UI is not a workflow editor or flow view.
findings.evidence: “New workflow definition” opens raw JSON. Existing workflows cannot be opened as editable typed nodes/ports/edges; there is no canvas, binding selector, validation display, run monitor, or diff.
findings.required_correction: Build a node/edge editor backed by the canonical schema, with JSON as an alternate synchronized view.
notes: Typed draggable nodes, ports, edges, binding/policy fields, synchronized JSON, structural validation, and existing-revision editing pass Edge and Chrome.

findings.finding: Node timeout is ignored.
findings.evidence: `execute` calls the executor directly; a probe with `timeout_seconds=0.01` and ~0.12 s sleep succeeded.
findings.required_correction: Execute under a supervised deadline and record timeout/cancellation.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Retry limit is ignored.
findings.evidence: `retry_limit` appears only in dry-run output. No retry loop/backoff/idempotency policy exists.
findings.required_correction: Implement bounded retry policy with attempt receipts and effect-safe idempotency.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Failure policy is ignored.
findings.evidence: `failure_policy` is stored but never read during execution.
findings.required_correction: Define and enforce supported policies; reject unknown values.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Edge condition is ignored.
findings.evidence: Every matching edge transfers data regardless of `WorkflowEdge.condition`; a probe using `condition:"never"` still propagated output.
findings.required_correction: Parse a closed condition language or use admitted predicate bindings; never silently treat unknown conditions as true.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Human approval is caller-asserted.
findings.evidence: `approvals` is a plain sequence of node IDs. No signed approver, scope, expiry, intent, or replay protection exists.
findings.required_correction: Resolve approval receipts from canonical authority and bind them to workflow/revision/run/node/effects.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Workflow binding/grant admission repeats the agent authority flaw.
findings.evidence: `validate_and_admit` trusts caller-created objects with `state:"admitted"` and an executor ID list.
findings.required_correction: Resolve canonical binding/grant/executor records and validate subject, effects, scope, expiry, cost, and egress.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Executors run unrestricted in-process.
findings.evidence: Arbitrary callbacks receive inputs and grant IDs, but no supervisor, sandbox, effect mediation, timeout, cancellation, or resource limits.
findings.required_correction: Execute admitted adapters behind the same owned process/effect boundary as other runtime operations.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Failures produce no durable failed-run receipt.
findings.evidence: Exceptions escape before receipt creation; only a final success receipt is written.
findings.required_correction: Create the run record before execution and append node/attempt/failure/cancel state atomically.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Port contracts accept invalid/ambiguous schemas.
findings.evidence: `WorkflowPort` has no validation. Blank/duplicate names and unknown data types can be constructed; multiple edges can drive one input; undeclared extra outputs are retained.
findings.required_correction: Validate names/types/uniqueness/cardinality and either reject or explicitly model fan-in and extra outputs.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: `effects_executed:true` is an assertion, not evidence.
findings.evidence: Any successful callback completion sets the flag, even if no effect ran or an undeclared effect ran.
findings.required_correction: Derive effect execution from mediated effect receipts; report declared, attempted, completed, denied separately.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: There is no cancel/resume/recovery model.
findings.evidence: Runs are synchronous and receipt-at-end only; crash recovery, pause, compensation, resume, and owner termination do not exist.
findings.required_correction: Add a durable run state machine and reconciliation on restart.
notes: Durable workflow pause/cancel/resume, completed-node checkpoints, fresh approval on retried effect nodes, stale-owner reconciliation, and crash-window recovery pass.

findings.finding: There is still no human skill editor.
findings.evidence: Skill Studio is a JSON manifest plus `source_directory`; users cannot edit `SKILL.md`, triggers, examples, resources, scripts, tests, permissions, or diffs in a guided surface. Existing skills cannot be edited.
findings.required_correction: Add a structured human editor, file tree/text editor, validation preview, diff, test run, and revision history.
notes: Guided manifest and bounded SKILL.md/capability/YAML/contracts/tests/resources editing, validation, diff, immutable staging, history, and canonical/preserved loading pass.

findings.finding: The API accepts an arbitrary absolute source directory.
findings.evidence: `studio_api.py:63-70` converts caller text directly to `Path`; there is no admitted source-root boundary or file picker token.
findings.required_correction: Require a user-selected/attested directory within an allowed root and revalidate its identity.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Nested directory symlinks can copy external data into a draft.
findings.evidence: `_tree` does not enumerate a directory symlink’s descendants, while `shutil.copytree(..., symlinks=False)` dereferences it. A probe copied an outside `private.txt` that was absent from the package record’s file list.
findings.required_correction: Reject every link/reparse point in the entire source tree and copy by verified no-follow handles; rehash the copied result.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Validation is non-idempotent.
findings.evidence: First validation writes `validation-receipt.json`; the next `_tree(root)` includes that receipt, changes the tree digest, and fails `tree_current`.
findings.required_correction: Exclude all studio metadata consistently or store receipts outside the sealed source tree.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Promotion trusts stale admission after tampering.
findings.evidence: `promote` checks only `decision:"admitted"`; it does not recompute the draft tree/manifest against the admitted hashes. A validate/admit/tamper/promote probe succeeded with altered `SKILL.md`.
findings.required_correction: Rehash immediately before promotion and verify signed admission identities.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Promotion does not integrate the skill into canonical catalogs or packaging.
findings.evidence: It copies to `.px/skills/<hash-suffixed-component>` but does not update `.px/skill-index.json`, `registry/skill_catalog.toml`, package records, `pyproject.toml` data files, build claims, or graphs.
findings.required_correction: Make promotion a transactional compiler/update across every authoritative projection, followed by current tests.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Rollback is claimed but not implemented.
findings.evidence: Module docstring/UI say promote/rollback; public methods end at `promote`. `rollback_available` is only a boolean.
findings.required_correction: Implement authenticated rollback with exact target identity, conflict check, atomic restore, and receipt.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.

findings.finding: Stage has a hash/copy time-of-check-to-time-of-use window.
findings.evidence: Source is hashed, then `copytree` copies it; the copied tree is not compared with the pre-copy rows before publish.
findings.required_correction: Copy into staging using no-follow semantics, hash staging, and publish only on exact match.

findings.finding: Normal text contrast repeatedly fails WCAG AA.

findings.required_correction: Raise contrast for all active informational text, then run automated and manual theme contrast checks.

findings.finding: Owned subprocess execution is broken on macOS and proc-less POSIX.
findings.evidence: `_process_start_fingerprint` sends every non-Windows OS to `/proc/<pid>/stat`. macOS has no Linux `/proc`; when the fingerprint is `None`, `ProcessSupervisor.run` terminates the child and raises “spawned process identity cannot be proven.” The same failure was reproduced in this proc-less audit host, including Agent harness launch.
findings.required_correction: Implement native macOS/BSD process birth identity (and a safe restricted-container strategy), then run supervisor, Agent, and governed-runner tests on every supported OS.
notes: Correction implemented and covered by the governed section/group evidence; final owned profile and validator run follow this ledger reconciliation.
